findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects such as the deployed vendor roster are not protected by an explicitly enforced bucket encryption policy or KMS key, leaving encryption guarantees dependent on provider defaults rather than this configuration.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Ledger export objects are not configured to use a bucket-enforced encryption algorithm or customer-managed key.

The bucket enables versioning and access logging but does not configure default server-side encryption. Model artifacts and their retained versions therefore lack explicitly enforced encryption at rest.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so runbook content and its retained versions are not protected by an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest setting.
